sources.sourceTitle: NCPOR Permanent Research Station Bharati — Official Profile & Geodetic Baseline
sources.sourceOrganization: National Centre for Polar and Ocean Research (NCPOR), Ministry of Earth Sciences
sources.rightsStatus: Open Access / Government of India Public Domain
sources.notes: Authoritative permanent station record. Bharati commissioned on 18 March 2012 at ~35 m ASL.

sources.sourceTitle: NCPOR Permanent Research Station Maitri — Official Profile & Oasis Baseline
sources.sourceOrganization: National Centre for Polar and Ocean Research (NCPOR), Ministry of Earth Sciences
sources.rightsStatus: Open Access / Government of India Public Domain

canonicalCoordinates.locationDescription: Schirmacher Oasis, Queen Maud Land, East Antarctica

sources.notes: Second Indian Antarctic research station, commissioned 1989 on ice-free rocky oasis.

sources.sourceTitle: NCPOR Historical Base Dakshin Gangotri — Archives & Transition Record
sources.sourceOrganization: Department of Ocean Development (now MoES) / NCPOR
sources.rightsStatus: Open Access / Government of India Public Domain

canonicalCoordinates.locationDescription: Dakshin Gangotri Glacier / Ice Shelf, Princess Astrid Coast

sources.notes: First permanent base (1983-1990), now maintained as historic preservation and summer camp.

sources.sourceTitle: Press Information Bureau / MoES: Launch of 41st Indian Scientific Expedition to Antarctica
sources.sourceOrganization: Ministry of Earth Sciences (MoES) / Press Information Bureau, Government of India
sources.rightsStatus: PIB Open Government Data / Official Release
sources.notes: 41st ISEA launched on 15 November 2021. Core programs: Amery Ice Shelf geology & ice-core drilling reconnaissance near Maitri.

sources.sourceTitle: National Polar Data Center (NPDC) — Automated Weather Station (AWS) Meteorological Master Catalogue
